_note: Rendered by the PACKAGES component on services.html. Prices read 'On request' because a two-day wedding and a four-day wedding are not the same number, and quoting a fake 'from' price to win a click wastes everyone's afternoon. Put real numbers here the moment you are happy to publish them.

items.name: The day itself
items.summary: One photographer, one day, from the morning preparations to the end of the reception.
includes: Up to twelve hours of coverage
Around 400 finished photographs, colour and black and white
A private online gallery your family can download from
A pre-wedding call to walk through the timeline
Full print and personal-use rights, in writing

items.name: The whole wedding
items.summary: Two photographers across every function, plus a film cut from the sound of the day.
includes: Two to four days, every function covered
Two photographers and a dedicated film unit
A six to nine minute film, plus a ninety second cut for sharing
A location and light recce before the date
An album designed with you, printed when you are ready

items.name: Portrait sitting
items.summary: An hour and a half, usually outdoors, usually near the end of the day.
includes: Ninety minutes, one or two locations
A short call beforehand about clothes and light

items.name: Editorial & brand
items.summary: A half or full day for rooms, makers, food and product, shot to a brief.
includes: Half day or full day on location
A shot list agreed before we arrive
Commercial licence for web and print
Files delivered sized for your channels
